code='''def transform(grid):
    # Move the four objects into the lower half, preserving their shapes.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if not col or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==col:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            objs.append((col,cells))
    # Source lower objects rise to the middle; upper objects descend to the bottom.
    for col,cells in objs:
        minr=min(y for y,x in cells); maxr=max(y for y,x in cells)
        minc=min(x for y,x in cells)
        target = (4 if minr>=4 else 7)
        dr=target-minr
        dc=(0 if minc<5 else -1)
        for y,x in cells:
            yy,xx=y+dr,x+dc
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w: out[yy][xx]=col
    return out
'''
